extension.summary: Shift+P pops the playing stream out into a floating, always-on-top window
extension.description: Press Shift+P while a video stream is playing to continue it in a small borderless mpv window that floats above every other window without stealing keyboard focus. The same window stays in place when Kodi auto-plays the next episode. Press Shift+P in Kodi again (or middle-click the PiP window) to close it. Requires mpv to be installed.
extension.news: 1.1.0 - One PiP window persists across episodes (auto-play next), Kodi is muted instead of paused by default 1.0.0 - Initial release
